I_2359.title: Unhandled undici promise rejections crash gateway during network blips
symptoms: Gateway process terminates during brief network interruptions
I_2359.root_cause: Unhandled promise rejections in undici HTTP library during transient network issues
I_2359.impact: UNACCEPTABLE for production - Service completely unavailable during minor network hiccups
I_2359.priority: P0 - MUST FIX before production deployment

I_2272.title: Gateway crashes on transient network failures (unhandled fetch rejection)
I_2272.root_cause: Lack of retry logic and error recovery for temporary network failures
I_2272.impact: Service terminates on temporary issues instead of recovering

I_2365.title: Session lock not released on API failure
I_2365.root_cause: Lock release logic missing in error handling paths
I_2365.impact: Sessions become permanently locked; requires manual cleanup

I_1812.title: Deadlock between cron timer lock and agent tool calls
I_1812.root_cause: Lock ordering issue causing mutual blocking
I_1812.impact: Complete system hang; requires process restart

I_1862.title: Messages lost during gateway restart (race condition)
I_1862.root_cause: Race condition during gateway shutdown/startup transition
I_1862.impact: MESSAGE LOSS - Zero-downtime deployments not possible

I_788.title: Messages/responses leak between providers (crosstalk)
I_788.impact: PRIVACY BREACH - Trust violation, potential regulatory violation

I_1826.title: Synthetic tool_result for terminated tool_use causes all subsequent requests to fail
I_1826.root_cause: Invalid synthetic tool results break API message format
I_1826.impact: Session becomes unusable after tool termination

I_2127.title: Critical: Main session context limits break heartbeat/monitoring system
I_2127.root_cause: Monitoring system shares context limits with user sessions

I_1568.title: PostgreSQL + pgvector backend for memory (alternative to SQLite)
I_1568.impact: BLOCKER - Current SQLite backend doesn't scale for enterprise workloads

I_1797.title: GitHub Copilot Enterprise accounts fail with HTTP 421 Misdirected Request
I_1797.impact: BLOCKER - Enterprise Copilot users cannot connect

I_2332.title: tool_use_id mismatch error with custom providers (e.g., Azure-hosted Claude)

I_1950.impact: BLOCKER - Cannot perform headless/automated Docker deployments

I_1808.title: Tool output bloat in sessions.jsonl

I_1808.impact: Storage explosion, performance degradation, service crashes

I_2304.title: Keeps forgetting what it's working on
